definitions.explanation: Sustained effort toward achieving a goal. Emphasizes hard work and perseverance.

examples.japanese: ⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧{努力|どりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{努力|どりょく}⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{叶|かな}う→叶う：05303_kanau⟧。
examples.english: If you make an effort, your dreams will come true.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{努力|どりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: His success is the result of his efforts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{努力|どりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's important to keep making an effort every day.

examples.japanese: {努力|どりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねて→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After sustained effort, I finally passed the exam.

notes:
USAGE: {努力|どりょく} is a highly valued concept in Japanese culture. Hard work and perseverance are seen as essential qualities.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {努力|どりょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make an effort)
- {努力|どりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧ (to make continued efforts)
- {努力|どりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{賜物|たまもの}→賜物：28125_tamamono⟧ (the fruit of one's efforts)
- {努力|どりょく}⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (hard worker)
- {努力|どりょく}⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧ (effort targets/goals)
- ⟦{不断|ふだん}→不断：24549_fudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{努力|どりょく} (constant effort)

CULTURAL NOTE: Japan values {努力|どりょく} highly. The belief that success comes from effort rather than innate talent is deeply ingrained. This is reflected in expressions like 「⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦{年|ねん}→〜年：09876_nen⟧」(perseverance will win in the end).

- ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧ (hardship, trouble)
